simple.meaning: עֹמֶד (ʻômed) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a spot (as being fixed).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, beginning at 2 Chronicles 30:16. The surrounding contexts include blood, covenant, commandment, Torah, kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹמֶד (H5977) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עֹמֶד (ʻômed) / H5977 is traced through 2 Chronicles 30:16, 2 Chronicles 34:31, 2 Chronicles 35:10, Nehemiah 8:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

majorEvents.label: Blood witness
majorEvents.evidenceText: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

timeline.evidenceText: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the Levites.

The king stood in his place, and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king’s commandment.

Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law; and the people stayed in their place.
They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed, and worshiped Yahweh their God.
Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
